Background:
<start of reference>
RELATED

HOLLAND, Mich. (WOOD) — There may be more entrepreneurs soon heading to West Michigan after business experts named Holland the best small city in the nation to start a business.

The tulip-speckled city beat out more than 1,200 other cities to earn the top spot on WalletHub's list, largely due to its access to resources, like investors and higher education assets.

"We're a place that people want to be," City Manager Keith Van Beek told 24 Hour News 8.

He said that support for new businesses is in Holland's "DNA and culture."

"We have a lot of great history and tradition of great ideas that were spawned in garages here that turned into fantastic large companies," Van Beek stated.

Eager entrepreneurs aren't the only people trying to set up shop in Holland.

"We've been trying for about two years to get downtown," said Jake Hogeboom, a broker at @Home Realty. "This was the third or fourth property that we made an offer on."

Hogeboom founded the company in Grand Haven six years ago. Months later, it expanded to the outskirts of Holland. His business outgrew that space and construction will soon wrap up on @Home Realty's new building at the corner of E. 7th Street and College Avenue.

Hogeboom said he's excited to be closer to the downtown energy.

"We love the development, we love what the city's doing (and) what the local developers are doing," he explained.

The company's new downtown location will boast a massive slide, offering transport from the second to first floor. It also features an in-house arcade.

However, the building will be much more than an adult playground. The third floor will transform into a space to support other businesses.

"We'll have 27 offices up there to rent out for smaller local businesses that just need one or two offices, that are looking to grow or start up businesses that can be a part of a building of this capacity but don't have the budget to go and get a big office in this location," Hogeboom explained.

Holland's economic development group, Lakeshore Advantage, seems to have played a big role in its WalletHub ranking. The city's access to investors as well as job growth between 2013 and 2017 helped thrust it to that No. 1 spot.
<end of reference>
Task:
Summarize the main reason why Holland, Michigan is a good place to start a business in at least 5 sentences aimed at high school students.
response_a:
1. Holland, Michigan is a great place to start a business because it offers easy access to resources such as investors and higher education institutions.
2. The city has a supportive culture for entrepreneurship, with a history of successful businesses starting in garages and turning into major companies.
3. Holland's economic development group, Lakeshore Advantage, plays a significant role in supporting new businesses and fostering job growth.
4. The city's affordable real estate market and vibrant downtown area make it an attractive location for entrepreneurs.
5. Holland's strong community spirit and commitment to supporting local businesses create a positive environment for startups to thrive.
response_b:
Holland, Michigan is a thriving community with a strong entrepreneurial spirit, making it an ideal place to start a business. Here are five reasons why:

1. Access to Resources: Holland offers a wide range of resources for aspiring entrepreneurs, including investment opportunities, higher education institutions, and business incubators. These resources provide valuable support and guidance to help businesses grow and succeed.
2. Strong Economic Development: Holland has experienced significant job growth over the past few years, indicating a healthy economy that supports new businesses. This growth creates opportunities for entrepreneurs to tap into existing markets and expand their customer base.
3. Collaborative Community: Holland's business community is known for its collaborative nature, with local entrepreneurs and business leaders working together to support new ventures. This supportive environment fosters innovation and encourages entrepreneurs to take risks and pursue their passions.
4. High Quality of Life: Holland offers a high quality of life, with a low cost of living, excellent schools, and a vibrant cultural scene. This attractive lifestyle makes it an appealing destination for entrepreneurs looking to build a sustainable and fulfilling business.
5. Diverse Industry Base: Holland's economy is diverse, with a mix of industries including manufacturing, healthcare, and tourism. This diversity provides entrepreneurs with a range of opportunities to explore, allowing them to capitalize on their unique skills and interests.

In summary, Holland, Michigan is an excellent place to start a business due to its access to resources, strong economic development, collaborative community, high quality of life, and diverse industry base. These factors create a supportive and exciting environment for entrepreneurs to thrive and achieve their goals.
